q_method: Exact original source action, narrationBeats, editorialProgress evaluated against the final timeline. q values are computed for each actual shutter sample.
cache_scope: Only three_days, treaty_talks, treaty, chain, at exact q0 or q1, excluding covers and first0.58s scene transition. Native dimensions, palette, geometry and seeds are immutable within the candidate HTML hash. Opaque illustrated frame is cached before text overlays; 3-sample composeFrame remains unchanged.
